what: On first open three cards fan out. The two side cards start from behind the center card (300px inward, 60px back, .94x) at .25s, slide out over 1.8s and rotate outward ∓12° (80px overlap). The center card drops from 32px above at .5s over 1.1s. All three appear from .5s.

options.--fx-turn: Angle at which side cards turn away, default 12deg
options.--fx-overlap: Distance the side cards overlap toward the center, default 80px
options.--fx-tuck: Distance hidden behind the center at the start, default 300px (side card width)

note: Side card width is up to whoever uses it (original 300px, center 400px). On phones, shrink the whole board with zoom .8/.65 like the original

from.where: index.html .ak-hero__cards (three cards: login · 2-step verification · app permissions)
